storage_lead: Where JGates keeps runs, drafts and plans on your computer, how much space each workspace uses and what retention deletes.
storage_relink_lead: The project is no longer at {path}. Enter the new folder: the history of this workspace will appear in the workspace of that folder. Nothing is copied or moved.
storage_relinked: History of {name} relinked to the new path.
storage_delete_preview: {runs} runs will be deleted, {size} in total.
storage_delete_marked: {count} of these runs are marked as baseline or preserved and will also be deleted.
storage_delete_scope: Only the folders below, inside the JGates data folder, are deleted:
storage_delete_project_safe: The project (which was at {path}) is not touched.
storage_retention_protected: Runs marked as baseline or preserved, and runs still being written, never enter the cleanup.
storage_retention_cli: shows the full list; jgates gc --yes deletes.
storage_images_unavailable: The container runtime did not answer, so the space of the images could not be read.
storage_images_none: No JGates image on this computer.
